aboutHeading: What a service visit actually includes
about:
Most people meet their spa company once and never see the same face again. That is how a tub ends up with cloudy water, a waterlogged cover and a heater nobody looked at.

Every visit is the same list, every time, and it takes about half an hour. You get a photo of the water and the chemistry readings on your phone before we drive away — so you know we came, and you know exactly where your water stands.

Same technician each visit. You will learn their name, and they will learn your equipment.
points: Test and balance bromine or chlorine, pH and alkalinity
Rinse the filter and check it for tears
Wipe the shell, waterline and jets
Check the heater, pump, blower and control panel
Top the water back up to level
Photo and readings sent to you before we leave
teamLede: The same person every visit, and the same person who answers when you call.
ctaLede: Call or text with your tub or pool size and where you are. We will give you a price on the phone — no site visit needed for regular service.
